title: CACHE_MODE_REPLACE silently fails when loaded resources have different types.
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]
- v4.8.dev.custom_build [d488d1111]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.3) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 (Apple9) - Apple M4 (10 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When a Resource's **type changes** and it's reloaded with `CACHE_MODE_REPLACE`, the reload silently fails. Cache still contains the _old_ resource.

```gdscript
ResourceLoader.load(some_uid, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)
```

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/d488d11119b4e0c67619b0c720d7c335ad2d0565/core/io/resource_loader.cpp#L590-L592


### Steps to reproduce

Admittedly, it's strange for a Resource to just _"change type"_ like I said. This happened to me when loading a pack file via [`ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_projectsettings.html#class-projectsettings-method-load-resource-pack) - and in the pack, the resource has a different type than what's in the game.

In my case, the type mismatch was between `CompressedTexture2D` and `ImageTexture`. Here's the story:

1. I made an export plugin, that shrinks all images to half their size. Smaller size → Faster web download → Download full resolution images at runtime, giving the users faster start. Simplified piece of the plugin code:

```gdscript
var scale: int = 4
func _customize_resource(resource: Resource, path: String) -> Resource:
	var texture := resource as Texture2D
	if not texture:
		return null
	var img: Image = texture.get_image()
	var target_width := maxi(1, roundi(img.get_width() / float(scale)))
	var target_height := maxi(1, roundi(img.get_height() / float(scale)))
	img.resize(target_width, target_height, Image.INTERPOLATE_LANCZOS)
	print("[export] Scaling down ", path.get_file().get_basename())
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
```

2. The plugin customizes resources in the project  - each `CompressedTexture2D` now became `ImageTexture` in the exported build.
3. I create a ZIP pack file from the export menu, selecting only images.
4. **In exported game build:**
5.  I download the ZIP, load it with `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack(download_location, true)`
6. For each of the images in the ZIP archive, I call `ResourceLoader.load(key, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_REPLACE)` to refresh the cache

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The pack files are pre-exported in the project. WORKS ONLY IN EDITOR, as `.zip` files aren't bundled with exported builds.

[mrp-cache-replace_2026-07-29_13-06-18.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30502276/mrp-cache-replace_2026-07-29_13-06-18.zip)
